title: Deep V-Neck Chiffon Ruffle Sleeve Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Elevate your wedding guest look with this stunning Deep V-Neck Chiffon Ruffle Sleeve Dress! Featuring delicate ruffle sleeves and a flattering silhouette, this dress flows beautifully, making it perfect for dancing the night away. Embrace elegance and charm at any celebration with this must-have piece!


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: High low.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
